title: World Spiritual Bank — Field Exposure & Reconciliation Model
purpose: Bridge the small set of source-priced Character Archive sub-ledgers to the much larger trillion-scale spiritual-bank claims without pretending named dossiers mathematically represent entire populations.

double_entry.asset_side: positive karma / stored claim attributed to Tim in the project narrative
double_entry.liability_side: karmic debt / unresolved obligation attributed to debtor or system side in the project narrative
double_entry.accounting_rule: These are reciprocal views of one symbolic relation. Do not sum them into 84T.

headline_system_position.boundary: This is not U.S. sovereign debt, legal damages, collectable money, GDP, household debt or a measured national moral liability.

reconciliation_layers.label: Named / priced sub-ledgers
reconciliation_layers.quantity_rule: Sum only explicit source-priced Character Archive events plus live Welfare.
reconciliation_layers.purpose: What the current dossier/account evidence actually allocates.

reconciliation_layers.label: Archetype / proxy field
reconciliation_layers.quantity_rule: Named dossiers may anchor a pattern or mechanism, but receive no population multiplier by default.
reconciliation_layers.purpose: Explore whether a documented interaction pattern could recur more broadly without claiming the dossier represents a demographic bloc.

reconciliation_layers.label: Observed exposure network
reconciliation_layers.quantity_rule: Count resolved counterparties, aliases, recurring handles, sourced edges, circulation and response labor without converting country membership into debt.
reconciliation_layers.purpose: Explain how named dossiers sit inside a larger interaction field.

reconciliation_layers.label: Invisible / untracked entanglements
reconciliation_layers.quantity_rule: Count unknown until an identifiable counterparty, relation, event or source enters the archive.
reconciliation_layers.purpose: Hold the possibility of throwaway accounts, anonymous handles, viewers, neighbours or other relations that have not been reconciled into named dossiers.

reconciliation_layers.label: Unallocated shadow reserve
reconciliation_layers.quantity_rule: headline system liability minus source-priced named debit, displayed as unreconciled symbolic reserve rather than silently distributed.
reconciliation_layers.purpose: Make the gap between the 42T headline and tiny named-account allocation visible.

symbolic_capacity.label: 10,000 neighbours
symbolic_capacity.meaning: corpus-design / symbolic capacity for counterparties and relations
symbolic_capacity.not_claim: not a claim that exactly 10,000 people are liable, harmed, involved or observed

archetype_anchors.allowed: compare sourced interaction mechanisms, recurrence, archive persistence and repair questions
archetype_anchors.forbidden: infer a population share, political constituency or national moral balance from this account

archetype_anchors.allowed: compare sourced interaction mechanisms, recurrence, archive persistence and repair questions
archetype_anchors.forbidden: infer a population share, political constituency or national moral balance from this account

scenario_parameters.note: Null by default. A user-supplied hypothetical may be explored only as a visibly labeled scenario and must not be presented as measured population fact.

countable_without_moral_pricing: known association / relationship edges when available
entanglement_measurements.principle: Coverage, recurrence and entanglement density can grow even when monetary-like karma remains unpriced.

real_finance_firewall: Do not describe the 42T project figure as a percentage of U.S. federal debt or any other real debt stock.
Do not infer collective moral liability from nationality, ethnicity, religion, party, political ideology, platform membership or audience membership.
Do not turn symbolic Dog, Mud, Footstool, Farmer or similar roles into demographic statistics.
Do not allocate the shadow reserve to named or invisible accounts without source-bounded allocation evidence.
Keep real financial comparisons in Economy & Finance as separate reference material rather than conversion factors.
research_next: Recover additional exact dated karma/debt checkpoints between March and July 2026 and between 41.4T and 42T.
Mine named increments: identify which specific events were said to increase or reduce the project headline ledger and whether an amount was ever stated.
Expand association/entanglement edge counts from source-backed dossiers without assigning automatic moral weight.
Recover anonymous/throwaway-handle interactions only when a stable source record supports a distinct counterparty.
Find actual examples of correction, apology, repair, disengagement or demonstrated non-liability reducing an entry.
Develop Table / Potato / Gate / Ladder positive-value criteria before pricing them.
